meta.title: User Activity / Audit Log: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin in the same Enterprise tenant, open User Activity/Audit Log, and compare whether the action is refused or available.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and a Tenant Admin in the same Enterprise tenant, open User Activity/Audit Log, and compare whether the action is refused or available.

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin and Tenant Admin users in the same Enterprise tenant, open User Activity / Audit Log for each, and record whether the action is refused or unavailable for the non-admin and available for the Tenant Admin

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch user roles or navigate and assert the User Activity / Audit Log permission outcome.
Assert the resulting screen has no crash or server error after the tester performs the role comparison.
